products.name: Celestial Bloom Embroidered Floral Hoop (10-inch)
products.description: Meticulously hand-embroidered on pure organic cotton linen using premium anchor cotton threads. Features intricate French knots, bullion roses, and celestial golden metallic thread accents. Mounted on a polished natural beechwood embroidery hoop ready to grace any wall.
products.shortDescription: Handcrafted 10-inch botanical floral embroidery with golden starry thread accents.

specifications.materials: 100% Cotton Linen, Egyptian Thread, Beechwood Hoop
specifications.careInstructions: Keep dry, dust gently with soft brush. Avoid prolonged intense sunlight.

products.customizationGuide: Custom initials, wedding dates, or quote embroidery can be stitched upon request.

products.name: Personalized Botanical Wedding Monogram Hoop
products.description: Celebrate lasting love with our signature heirloom wedding hoop. Stitched with delicate wild blossoms, eucalyptus sprigs, and the couple’s entwined monogram initials and significant date in shimmering metallic thread.
products.shortDescription: Customized couple wedding and anniversary embroidery hoop with monogram.

specifications.materials: Unbleached Organic Muslin, German Anchor Floss, Wood Frame
specifications.careInstructions: Dust with clean dry cloth. Store in temperate indoor spaces.

products.customizationGuide: Please enter Couple Names and Wedding/Anniversary Date in the order notes.

products.name: Azure Ocean Wave Resin Wall Clock (14-inch Silent Quartz)
products.description: Capturing the wild beauty of turquoise ocean tides crashing against golden sandy shores. Made with multilayered art-grade UV-resistant crystal resin on seasoned MDF wood, finished with sleek gold clock hands and a silent sweep quartz movement.
products.shortDescription: 14-inch handcrafted resin ocean tide wall clock with silent quartz movement.

specifications.materials: Non-Toxic Art Resin, Real Beach Sand, Quartz Sweep Mechanism
specifications.careInstructions: Wipe with microfiber cloth. Keep away from direct heaters or radiators.

products.customizationGuide: Custom diameters and numbering font styles available upon request.

products.name: Gilded Geode Resin Coasters (Set of 6 with Holder)
products.description: Transform your coffee table into an opulent gallery. Hand-cast geode-inspired coasters accented with translucent emerald and cream pigments, shimmering mica crystals, and luxurious hand-painted 24K liquid gold leaf edges.
products.shortDescription: Luxury set of 6 heat-resistant crystal resin coasters with gold-leafed rims.

specifications.materials: Heat-Resistant Food Safe Resin, Mica Pigments, Liquid Leaf
specifications.careInstructions: Hand wash with mild soapy water. Not dishwasher or microwave safe.

products.customizationGuide: Can be customized in blush rose, sapphire blue, or smoky quartz hues.

products.name: Hand-Painted Chanderi Silk Floral Dupatta
products.description: Exquisite hand-painted botanical artwork on sheer, lightweight pure Chanderi silk. Features freehand vintage English roses in soft coral, sage green, and dust gold accents. Color-fast textile pigments ensure durable, lasting vibrance.
products.shortDescription: Bespoke hand-painted floral motifs on pure Chanderi silk dupatta (2.5m).

specifications.materials: Pure Chanderi Silk, Non-Toxic Permanent Fabric Acrylics
specifications.careInstructions: Dry clean only or gentle hand wash in cold water with mild detergent.

products.customizationGuide: Custom base fabric colors and personalized floral patterns available.

products.name: Artisanal Hand-Painted Canvas Tote Bag (Sunflowers)
products.description: A charming, eco-friendly lifestyle tote made from thick, durable 12oz natural cotton canvas. Hand-painted with cheerful Vincent-inspired textured sunflowers that bring sunshine to your daily errands and book carrying.
products.shortDescription: 12oz heavy-duty natural cotton canvas tote hand-painted with textured sunflowers.

specifications.materials: 100% Heavy Organic Cotton Canvas, Washable Acrylic Mediums
specifications.careInstructions: Turn inside out, gentle hand wash in cold water, iron on reverse side.

products.customizationGuide: Custom names or initials can be painted alongside the floral motif.

products.name: Custom Realistic Charcoal Couple Portrait (A3 Size Framed)
products.description: Turn your favorite cherished photograph into a timeless fine-art heirloom. Hand-drawn by Komal Kang using artist-grade willow charcoal and blending stumps on 250gsm acid-free Strathmore paper. Delivered fully framed with museum-quality glass.
products.shortDescription: Hand-drawn lifelike charcoal portrait framed on archival heavyweight paper.

specifications.materials: Derwent Willow & Compressed Charcoal, 250gsm Archival Paper, Teak Frame
specifications.dimensions: A3 (11.7 x 16.5 inches) with 1-inch outer frame
specifications.careInstructions: Treated with archival fixative. Display out of direct dampness.

products.customizationGuide: Submit your high-resolution reference photo via the Custom Order page or checkout note.

products.name: Hand-Carved Wooden Keepsake Gift Box with Velvet Lining
products.description: Exquisitely handcrafted from seasoned mango wood with delicate brass filigree inlays and floral carvings. Inside features a plush crimson velvet lining ideal for jewelry, love letters, and sacred keepsakes.
products.shortDescription: Hand-carved solid mango wood keepsake box with brass floral inlays.

specifications.materials: Seasoned Mango Wood, Antique Brass Inlay, Micro-Velvet
specifications.careInstructions: Polish with natural beeswax twice a year. Keep away from excess water.

products.customizationGuide: Laser engraved or hand-pyrographed personal message inside lid available.

products.name: Personalized Couple Photo Preservation Resin Night Lamp
products.description: Immortalize your favorite memories inside crystal-clear resin preserved with dried baby’s breath flowers and gold sparkles. Embedded in a solid warm beechwood LED base that casts a cozy ambient glow across your bedroom.
products.shortDescription: Warm LED beechwood night lamp with custom photo preserved in crystal resin.

specifications.materials: Optical Crystal Resin, Real Preserved Botanicals, Solid Beechwood Base
specifications.dimensions: 6 inches height x 4.5 inches width x 2 inches depth
specifications.careInstructions: Powered via USB 5V cable (included). Wipe resin surface with soft cloth.

products.customizationGuide: Upload your photo and couple names for seamless resin encapsulation.

products.name: Bohemian Artisan Macrame Wall Hanging with Driftwood
products.description: A striking statement textile piece knotted by hand using 100% natural unbleached single-twist cotton cord. Suspended from hand-collected, naturally smoothed river driftwood for an authentic organic aesthetic.
products.shortDescription: Large hand-knotted organic cotton macrame tapestry on natural driftwood.

specifications.materials: 100% Virgin Cotton Cord (4mm), Natural Driftwood Branch
specifications.dimensions: 18 inches wide branch, 28 inches hanging drop length
specifications.careInstructions: Gently comb fringe tassels with a wide-tooth comb as desired.

products.name: Personalized Botanical Resin Alphabet Keychain with Real Flowers
products.description: Carry a miniature garden wherever you journey. Each alphabet letter is painstakingly hand-cast with crystal-clear non-yellowing resin, real pressed forget-me-nots and baby’s breath, and a touch of gold foil, paired with a matching suede tassel.
products.shortDescription: Custom initial resin keychain with real preserved botanicals and gold leafing.

specifications.materials: UV Hardened Epoxy Resin, Natural Dried Flowers, Stainless Steel Ring
specifications.careInstructions: Durable and shatter-resistant for daily key ring use.

products.customizationGuide: Specify the required Alphabet Letter (A-Z) in the customization note.

reviews.name: Simran Kaur (Chandigarh)
reviews.comment: The French knot detailing on this embroidery hoop is beyond words! It was packed so lovingly with dried flower sprigs. The quality and patience Komal puts in is truly heartwarming.

reviews.name: Vikramjit Singh (Mohali)
reviews.comment: Received the 14-inch ocean resin clock yesterday. It looks even more vibrant in person than in the photos! The silent quartz movement is completely noiseless. A masterpiece on my wall.
